violations.detail: Plan promises "hypertrophy" but duration is 2wk — that adaptation is not physiologically deliverable in this window.

exercises.name: Easy reps of first movement pattern
Good morning hinge with towel isometric
Hip hinge isometric: good morning against doorframe
Alternating reverse lunge to split-squat pulse
Mobility work (hip flexor and calf focus)

notes: Goal: maintenance not progression; keep 70–80% usual weekly set volume using bodyweight, isometrics, and tempo.
Prioritize higher-rep sets, tempo control, short rests, and proximity to failure to maintain intensity.
Frequency 5 days/week with 2 recovery days; sessions ~35–50 minutes.
Warm-up: 5–7 minutes of joint circles, cat-cow, world’s greatest stretch, then 20–30 easy reps of first movement pattern.
Cooldown: 3–5 minutes light mobility and nasal breathing.
Daily optional: 10–20 minute easy walk.

Weekly structure both weeks: Day 1 Pull + Core; Day 2 Lower Push + Calves; Day 3 Push; Day 4 Lower Hinge/Glutes + Hamstrings; Day 5 Full-Body Density + Conditioning; Day 6 Mobility/Active Recovery; Day 7 Off.
Pulling intensity: use varied grips, tempo, and mechanical drop sets (strict to assisted to isometric holds).
Legs: favor unilateral work like pistol box squat progression and split squats.
Chest/shoulders: use tempo push-ups, pike presses, slow eccentrics and long pauses.
Where reps are high, split into clusters to maintain form.
After last full-rep pull-up set, add 1–2 cluster mini-sets or switch to foot-on-chair assist to reach 20–30 total quality reps.
Inverted row option: elevate feet on bed for harder.
Core ladder: 3 rounds with 15s rest between rounds.
Finisher: dead hang 2 x max hold but not to failure; keep shoulder position.
Day 5 performed as circuit for 4–5 rounds, 45s work / 15s transition, 2–3 min between rounds.
Pull-up cluster within 45s window EMOM style; use light assist to keep quality.
Optional finisher EMOM 6–8 minutes with alternating minutes of burpees and mountain climbers (low impact if hotel noise is a concern).
Day 6 Mobility/Active Recovery: 20–30 minutes of listed mobility and nasal breathing walk if available.
Day 7 Off: light walking and gentle stretching only.
Week 2: keep structure; make minor adjustments to maintain stimulus without chasing progression.
Mixed-grip pull-ups: add 5–10s mid-rep isometric at 90° elbow on last rep each set.
Feet-elevated inverted rows or slow door rows as variation.
Core: hanging knee raise or dead-bug if bar setup isn’t safe.
Day 5 Week 2 circuit same work/rest; include handstand holds if safe.
Optional finisher Week 2: EMOM 6–8 minutes with squat thrusts on odd minutes and low-bounce jumping jacks or fast marching on even minutes.
Warm-up constraints: if space is tight, do 2 minutes brisk in-room marching, 20 air squats, 10 pike walkouts, 20 scap pull-ups or door rows.
Ensure door pull-up bar is secure; avoid kipping or swinging; use non-slip surface for rows; ensure bed/chair stability for dips and thrusts.
Resume week 7 of hypertrophy block with a normal reintroduction session after return.

raw_text:
Here’s a focused 2-week hotel-room maintenance plan designed to preserve muscle and movement quality while she’s away. It uses only a yoga mat and a door pull-up bar, prioritizes sufficient total weekly volume via higher-rep sets, tempo control, and short rest intervals, and keeps intensity via proximity to failure. Sessions are ~35–50 minutes. Frequency: 5 days/week with 2 recovery days.

Guiding principles
- Goal: Maintenance, not progression. Keep 70–80% of her usual weekly set volume per muscle group via bodyweight variations and isometric/tempo strategies.
- Intensity: Take most working sets to 1–2 reps in reserve (RIR); last set of each exercise can go to near-failure safely.
- Tempo and pauses: Use 3–4 sec eccentrics, 1–2 sec pauses, and extended-range positions to increase mechanical tension.
- Rest: 45–75 sec between sets for large patterns; 30–45 sec for smaller muscles.
- Warm-up: 5–7 minutes: joint circles, cat-cow, world’s greatest stretch, 20–30 easy reps of the first movement pattern.
- Cooldown: 3–5 minutes light mobility and nasal breathing.
- Daily optional: 10–20 min easy walk if possible.

Weekly structure (both weeks)
- Day 1: Pull + Core
- Day 2: Lower Push (Quads) + Calves
- Day 3: Push (Chest/Shoulders/Tris)
- Day 4: Lower Hinge/Glutes + Hamstrings
- Day 5: Full-Body Density + Conditioning Finisher
- Day 6: Mobility/Active Recovery
- Day 7: Off

Intensity notes
- For pulling, use pull-up bar with tempo, varied grips, and mechanical drop sets (e.g., strict to assisted to isometric holds).
- For legs, use unilateral work (pistol box squat progression, split squats) to drive stimulus.
- For chest/shoulders, use tempo push-ups, pike presses, and extended-range positions via slow eccentrics and long pauses.
- Where reps are high, split into clusters to stay within good form.

Week 1

Day 1 – Pull + Core
1) Pull-ups or Chin-ups (neutral/supinated if available)
- 5 sets x 4–8 reps @ 2–3 sec eccentric + 1 sec chin-over-bar pause; 60–90s rest
- After last full-rep set, add 1–2 cluster mini-sets of 2–3 reps with 15s intra-set rest, or switch to foot-on-chair light assist to reach 20–30 total quality reps.
2) Inverted Door Row (towel around bar for grip; knees bent, body at angle)
- 4 sets x 10–15 reps @ 3 sec eccentric; 45–60s rest
- Option: Elevate feet on bed for harder.
3) Towel/Bath-Sheet Lat Pullover Iso
- 3 sets x 20–30 sec isometric hold: kneel, towel looped over bar, hips back, straight arms “pull” ribs toward hips; 30–45s rest
4) Doorframe Rear Delt Sweep
- 3 sets x 12–15/side slow; 2–3 sec stretch at end range; 30–45s rest
5) Core: Hollow Body Ladder
- 3 rounds: 20s hold + 10s tuck; 15s rest between rounds
Finisher: Dead Hang from bar 2 x max hold (not to failure; keep shoulder position)

Day 2 – Lower Push (Quads) + Calves
1) Rear-Foot-Elevated Split Squat (front foot on floor, rear foot on bed/chair)
- 4 sets x 10–15/leg @ 3–4 sec eccentric + 1–2 sec bottom pause; 60–75s rest
2) Cyclist Squats (heels elevated on rolled mat/towels, narrow stance)
- 4 sets x 15–20 @ 3 sec down, continuous tension; 60s rest
3) Tempo Pistol to Box/Bed (to comfortable depth)
- 3 sets x 6–10/leg @ 3 sec down; 60s rest
4) Long-Lever Copenhagen Plank (knee on edge of bed)
- 3 sets x 20–30s/side; 30–45s rest
5) Standing Single-Leg Calf Raise off folded towel
- 4 sets x 12–20/leg with 2 sec peak squeeze + 3 sec eccentric; 30–45s rest

Day 3 – Push (Chest/Shoulders/Triceps)
1) Tempo Push-Ups
- 5 sets x 8–15 @ 3–4 sec eccentric + 1 sec pause chest-hover; 60–75s rest
- Mechanical dropset on last set: standard to knees to long-lever plank push-ups.
2) Pike Handstand Push-Up (hips high; head to mat)
- 4 sets x 6–12 @ 3 sec down + 1 sec bottom pause; 60–75s rest
3) Decline or Deficit Push-Ups (feet on bed or hands on yoga blocks/towels for ROM)
- 3 sets x 8–12 slow; 60s rest
4) Doorframe Lateral Raise Iso-Sweeps (lean, abduct against frame)
- 3 sets x 12–15/side + 10–15s top iso hold; 30–45s rest
5) Triceps: Close-Grip Push-Ups or Bench Dips off bed (shoulders packed)
- 3 sets x 10–15 with 2–3 sec eccentrics; 45–60s rest

Day 4 – Lower Hinge/Glutes + Hamstrings
1) Single-Leg Hip Thrust (shoulders on bed)
- 4 sets x 10–15/leg with 3 sec top squeeze + 3 sec eccentric; 60s rest
2) Sliding Hamstring Curls (heels on small towels on smooth floor)
- 4 sets x 8–12 slow concentric + 3–4 sec eccentric; 60–75s rest
- Regression: eccentric-only with hip lift assist on the way back.
3) Good Morning Hinge with Towel Iso (towel under feet, hands pulling up)
- 3 sets x 12–15 with constant tension 3–3 tempo; 45–60s rest
4) Reverse Lunge (slow)
- 3 sets x 10–12/leg with 2 sec pause in bottom; 60s rest
5) Side Plank with Hip Abduction
- 3 sets x 8–12 top-leg raises per side + 20s side plank hold after each; 30–45s rest

Day 5 – Full-Body Density + Conditioning
Perform as circuit for 4–5 rounds; 45s work / 15s transition; 2–3 min between rounds.
- A) Pull-Up Cluster: sets of 2–4 reps EMOM style within the 45s window; use light assist if needed to keep quality.
- B) Deficit or Standard Push-Ups
- C) Split Squat Pulse (half-bottom range) + full reps combination
- D) Pike Shoulder Taps (controlled) or Elevated Pikes
- E) Hollow-to-Dead Bug Alternating
Optional finisher: 6–8 minutes EMOM: odd minutes 8–10 burpees; even minutes 30–40 mountain climbers (low impact if hotel noise is a concern).

Day 6 – Mobility/Active Recovery
- 20–30 minutes: hip flexor and adductor series, thoracic rotations, shoulder CARs, hamstring flossing, deep squat holds with prying, nasal breathing walk if available.

Day 7 – Off
- Light walking and gentle stretching only.

Week 2
Keep the same structure; make minor adjustments to maintain stimulus without chasing progression.

Day 1 – Pull + Core (variation)
1) Mixed-Grip Pull-Ups (change grip width)
- 5 sets x 4–8 reps, same tempo; add 5–10s mid-rep isometric at 90° elbow on last rep each set.
2) Feet-Elevated Inverted Rows (if feasible) or Slow Door Rows
- 4 sets x 10–12 @ 4 sec eccentric + 2 sec stretch.
3) Towel Straight-Arm Pressdowns (kneel facing away from bar, towel over bar, press down)
- 3 sets x 12–15 slow.
4) Y-T-W Isos prone on mat
- 3 sets x 8–10 each pattern with 2–3s holds.
5) Core: Hanging Knee Raise or Dead-Bug if bar setup isn’t safe
- 4 sets x 8–12 or 10–15/side.

Day 2 – Lower Push + Calves (variation)
1) Front-Foot-Elevated Split Squat (front foot on towel/low object)
- 4 sets x 10–14/leg with 2–3s pause near bottom.
2) Tempo Narrow-Stance Squats (heels elevated)
- 4 sets x 15–18 continuous tension.
3) Sissy Squat (bodyweight, heels high, hold onto doorframe lightly)
- 3 sets x 8–12 slow range you control.
4) Copenhagen Plank (longer lever than W1 if tolerable)
- 3 sets x 25–35s/side.
5) Soleus Emphasis Calf Raise (knee bent 20–30°)
- 4 sets x 15–25/leg with slow tempo.

Day 3 – Push (variation)
1) Tempo Deficit Push-Ups or Ring/Bar Push-Up Bottom Holds (hands elevated on books/towels)
- 5 sets x 8–12 @ 3–4 sec down, 2 sec bottom.
2) Elevated Pike/Handstand Push-Up Progression
- 4 sets x 6–10; add partials at end-range.
3) Archer Push-Up or Uneven Push-Up (one hand elevated)
- 3 sets x 6–8/side slow.
4) Doorframe Lateral Raise + Front Raise combo
- 3 rounds: 10–12 lateral + 10–12 front each side.
5) Triceps Extended ROM: Bed Dips with 2–3 sec pause bottom
- 3 sets x 10–15.

Day 4 – Lower Hinge/Glutes + Hamstrings (variation)
1) B-Stance Hip Thrust (80/20 load bias)
- 4 sets x 12–15/side with 3s top squeeze.
2) Single-Leg Sliding Curl (eccentric focus)
- 4 sets x 6–10/leg; assist concentric as needed.
3) Hip Hinge Isometric: Good Morning Against Doorframe (push hips back, hands on frame)
- 3 x 30–40s holds.
4) Step-Back Lunge to Knee Drive (balance + glute med)
- 3 sets x 10–12/leg slow.
5) Side Plank Thread-the-Needle
- 3 sets x 8–12/side + 15–20s hold after.

Day 5 – Full-Body Density + Conditioning (variation)
Circuit 4–5 rounds; 45s work / 15s transition.
- A) Pull-Up Eccentrics: jump/assist up, 3–5 sec down, 3–5 reps per work window.
- B) Push-Up Ladder: 5-4-3-2-1 reps repeat within 45s, steady tempo.
- C) Alternating Reverse Lunge to Split-Squat Pulse combo.
- D) Pike Shoulder Shift + Handstand Hold (wall-assisted if safe) 10–20s holds.
- E) V-Sit or Tuck-Up to Hollow Rock.
Optional finisher: 6–8 minutes EMOM: odd minutes 12–15 squat thrusts (no jump); even minutes 30–40 low-bounce jumping jacks or fast marching.

Day 6 – Mobility/Active Recovery
- Repeat Week 1 or choose tight areas; include 2–3 minutes per side of hip flexor and calf work.

Day 7 – Off

Recovery, nutrition, and travel tips
- Protein: Maintain 1.6–2.2 g/kg/day. Anchor with 3–4 feedings of 25–40 g complete protein; include one before bed if daily total is low.
- Calories: Aim for maintenance. If activity is reduced, slightly lower carbs/fats to prevent unwanted gain, but avoid aggressive deficit to protect muscle.
- Hydration: 2.5–3.5 L/day; add electrolytes if flying or in hot climates.
- Sleep: Prioritize 7–9 hours; use wind-down, eye mask, and cool room. If jet-lagged, morning light and short 10–20 min naps.
- Soreness management: Keep RIR 1–2 on most sets; swap high-impact finishers if hotel noise or joints protest.
- Warm-up constraints: If space is tight, do 2 minutes of brisk in-room marching, 20 air squats, 10 pike walkouts, 20 scap pull-ups or door rows.

Safety/Equipment notes
- Ensure the door pull-up bar is secure on the specific doorframe. Avoid kipping or swinging. For rows, keep feet on non-slip surface. For bed dips or thrusts, ensure a stable surface.

This 2-week plan will maintain muscle via sufficient volume, proximity to failure, and strategic tempo, without requiring progression. When she returns, resume week 7 of her hypertrophy block with a normal reintroduction session to recalibrate loads.
